summary: A typical network project tree has playbooks, inventory, group_vars per platform, roles and a backup directory that config modules create when backup: true is set.
questions: How should I lay out my Ansible network project directory?
Where do network config backups get saved?

answer_card.title: Typical network project layout
answer_card.answer_md:
```text
.
├── backup/          # created by e.g. vyos_config with backup: true
├── first_playbook.yml
├── inventory
├── group_vars/
│   ├── vyos.yml
│   └── eos.yml
└── roles/
    ├── static_route/
    └── system/
```
